header.name: §bRealistic Deferred§r — Vibrant Visuals
header.description:
Realistic shader for Bedrock Vibrant Visuals (deferred rendering).
Fresnel-reflective water with glowing sun glint, turquoise shallows & deep-blue depths,
underwater depth shading, glossy reflective surfaces, warm/cool color grading, soft corner AO,
volumetric fog & bloom.
§7Shader only — no custom block textures. Windows 10/11 · v26.21 (engine 1.21.120+)§r
